bed_type.title: Bett-Typ
bed_type.description:
Welchen Typ Bett möchtest du steuern?

**Wasserbett:** Hohe thermische Masse (300-700L Wasser). Langsames Aufheizen (~0.7°C/h), speichert Wärme wie eine Batterie. Min. 24°C (Kondensationsschutz!), sanfte Rampen (1°C/h max).

**Heizmatte:** Niedrige thermische Masse. Schnelles Aufheizen (Minuten!), keine Wärmespeicherung. Kann komplett AUS sein, keine Rampen-Limits nötig.

safety_info.title: ⚠️ Sicherheitshinweis
safety_info.description:
**WICHTIG:** Stelle sicher, dass der physische Thermostat deiner Bett-Heizung auf **MAXIMUM (38°C)** gestellt ist!

Nur so kann Home Assistant die Temperatur präzise regeln.

**Für Wasserbetten:** Die Mindesttemperatur von 24°C verhindert Kondensation und Schimmel. Niemals die Heizung komplett abschalten!

**Der Hardware-Thermostat bleibt als Sicherheits-Backup im Stromkreis!**

zone_sensors.title: 📡 Select Zone
zone_sensors.description: Which zone would you like to edit?

edit_zone_sensors.title: 📡 Sensors – {zone_name}
edit_zone_sensors.description: Hardware assignment for this zone. Only the heater switch is required, all other fields are optional.

data_description.heater: The switch or relay that controls the heater — e.g. a smart plug, Zigbee switch or input_boolean.
data_description.temp_sensor: Temperature sensor in the water or on the mattress. Without this sensor only basic mode (timer) is available. With sensor: full biorhythm curve, presence detection and calibration.
data_description.power_sensor: Power sensor from the smart plug in watts. Enables energy statistics, savings calculation and improves presence detection.
data_description.presence_sensor: Dedicated presence sensor such as a pressure mat or mmWave radar. Without this sensor the system detects occupancy via temperature analysis.
data_description.moisture_sensor: Humidity sensor for sweat detection and leak alarm. Can be an SHT41 or a separate humidity sensor.
data_description.air_temp_sensor: Second temperature sensor on top of the mattress core, e.g. an SHT41. Measures the surface between mattress and blanket. Enables blanket check, sweat detection 2.0 and better presence detection through body heat.

zone_settings.title: 🌡️ Select Zone
zone_settings.description: Which zone's sleep profile would you like to adjust?

edit_zone_settings.title: 🌡️ Sleep Profile – {zone_name}
edit_zone_settings.description: Sleep times, chronotype, temperatures and wearable for this bed side. In a dual bed, both sides can have different times and settings.

data_description.warm_from: When should this side start being warm? Preheating starts automatically earlier.
data_description.warm_until: Until when should it stay warm? Also serves as wake-up time for the biorhythm curve.
data_description.chronotype: Determines the lowest point of the temperature curve. Early birds reach it sooner, night owls later.
data_description.alarm_entity: Sensor with next alarm time, e.g. sensor.next_alarm.
data_description.weekend_offset_hours: How many hours to shift the wake-up time on weekends.
data_description.sleep_temp: Temperature at sleep onset. Empty = seasonal automatic (summer ~27°C, winter ~29°C).
data_description.deep_sleep_temp: Coolest point during deep sleep. Empty = seasonal automatic (summer ~26°C, winter ~27.5°C).
data_description.wake_temp: Temperature at wake-up. Empty = seasonal automatic (summer ~28°C, winter ~30°C).
data_description.sleep_stage_entity: Sleep stages from Fitbit, Withings or Apple Watch. Overrides the biorhythm curve.

mode_settings.title: 🎛️ Special Modes
mode_settings.description: Temperature settings for sick, boost and away modes.

data_description.sick_mode_temp: Constant temperature during sick mode. Recommended: 30–32°C for muscle relaxation and recovery.
data_description.sick_mode_days: How many days sick mode stays active before automatically deactivating.
data_description.boost_target_temp: Fixed target temperature during quick heating (boost). Recommended: 32–34°C.
data_description.away_temp: Holding temperature during away mode. For waterbeds never below 24°C due to condensation and vinyl protection. Recommended: 24–25°C.

global_times.title: 🌡️ Temperature & Bed
global_times.description: System-wide temperature limits and bed properties.

data_description.summer_cutoff_enabled: When enabled, heating is reduced above the summer threshold. Turn off to keep the normal sleep profile all year regardless of outdoor temperature.
data_description.summer_threshold: Above this outdoor temperature the system enters summer mode. Recommended: 25°C.
data_description.temperature_offset: Fine-tune all temperatures. +1.0 = everything 1°C warmer, -1.0 = cooler.
data_description.bed_volume_liters: Water volume in liters. Guidelines: 250 L single, 400 L double, 700 L king-size. Used for thermal battery and heating time.

global_sensors.title: 📊 Sensors & Electricity Price
global_sensors.description:
Electricity price and room sensors. Solar & battery have their own section.

**Electricity price** — Your current tariff in ct/kWh. Used for savings calculation and as fallback without a price sensor.

**Price sensor** — Dynamic electricity price from Tibber, Octopus or ENTSO-E. Overrides the fixed tariff and enables Eco mode.

**CO₂ sensor** — CO₂ in the bedroom for the sleep score (25% weight).

data_description.electricity_price: Your current electricity tariff. Used for savings calculation and as fallback without a price sensor.
data_description.price_sensor: Overrides the fixed price with real-time data and enables Eco mode.
data_description.co2_sensor: CO₂ in the bedroom for the sleep score.

global_solar.title: ☀️ Solar & Battery
global_solar.description:
Solar Boost charges the bed (thermal mass) from PV surplus. Three independent triggers — any one fires the boost, and only the sensors you configure count.

**Solar sensor** — PV power in watts (e.g. Fronius, SMA, Huawei).

**Solar threshold** — Minimum surplus in watts to activate boost. Set at least as high as the bed's heater power (e.g. 300 W single, 600 W double).

**Battery SoC (optional)** — Independent trigger: the boost also fires once SoC reaches the threshold (battery full → use the surplus). Works on its own and alongside the solar threshold.

**PV forecast (optional)** — Another independent trigger: the boost also fires when the remaining-day forecast is generous. Leave empty and nothing changes.

**Home battery priority (optional)** — Off by default. Turn it on to give the battery/boiler priority: the solar threshold then only fires when the battery is (nearly) full *or* the forecast is generous (the classic gating behaviour).

data.bed_boost_soc_threshold: Battery SoC threshold for bed boost

data_description.solar_sensor: PV power in watts. Solar Boost activates above the solar threshold.
data_description.solar_boost_threshold: PV surplus in watts needed to activate Solar Boost. For a double bed with 600 W heater, set to 600 W or higher.
data_description.battery_soc_sensor: State of charge of your home battery in percent. Independent trigger: the boost also fires once SoC reaches the threshold — works on its own and alongside the solar threshold.
data_description.bed_boost_soc_threshold: Battery SoC at which the SoC trigger fires the boost. Default 90%. 5% hysteresis (releases below 85%).
data_description.forecast_sensor: Optional. PV forecast in kWh remaining for the rest of the day (e.g. sensor.solcast_pv_forecast_forecast_remaining_today).
data_description.bed_boost_min_forecast_kwh: Remaining PV forecast at which the forecast trigger fires the boost. Default 3 kWh. Hysteresis 1 kWh.
data_description.battery_priority: Off (default): solar threshold, SoC and forecast are independent OR-triggers — any one fires the boost. On: the home battery/boiler get priority — the solar threshold only fires when the battery is (nearly) full or the forecast is generous. Without a battery/forecast sensor this has no effect.
